Question: Kya agar kisi wali ya auliyaki mazar pe jakar yeh kahena ki ya shaikh, ya gauth aap meri duva allah ki bargah me pahocha dijiye, aap mere liye duva kare, allah aapki duva bahoot jald kabool karte hai, kya aisa aqida rakhna durast hai ya nahi. Aur dusra kya ek muslman ko barelvi bhi nahi hai aur deobandi bhi nahi to kya woh muslman hoga, matlabt woh ahle sunnatval jamat par kayam rahega ya nahi. Answer ID: 12385 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 705/705=M/1430) It is right to pray Allah with the intermediation of any pious man e.g. ?O Allah! Fulfil my need with the waseelah of so and so pious man!? But, the sentence mentioned in the question is not right; neither is it proved to have such belief. Ahlus Sunnah will be one who will have beliefs according to the Ahlus Sunnah wal Jama?ah. We people of Deoband believe in the same, al-hamdulillah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
